killings.feud_name: Freydís vs the brothers Helgi and Finnbogi in Vínland
killings.note: Freydís present and directing; hands were her husband Þorvarður's men (Þorvarður led them and might also count). She wanted the brothers' larger ship and goods, pretending they had beaten her.

killings.evidence: gengu inn að þeim sofundum og tóku þá og færðu í bönd ... en Freydís lét drepa hvern sem út kom.
killings.feud_name: Freydís vs the brothers Helgi and Finnbogi in Vínland
killings.note: As KN048.

killings.evidence: Og þegar hann þóttist í skotfæri við hann skaut hann til hans spjóti ... Fellur hann þegar dauður til jarðar.
killings.note: Same killing as KL106 (Droplaugarsona saga, Þorgrímur tordýfill). Fully narrated here too, not a passing reference.

killings.evidence: tekur sverðið hinni vinstri hendi og höggur til Ketils og í gegnum hann. Ketill fellur þá dauður til jarðar.
killings.relation_detail: Ketill is Þiðrandi's mother's brother ("láttu mig njóta móður minnar en systur þinnar")
killings.feud_name: Þiðrandi Geitisson vs his uncle Ketill þrymur in Njarðvík
killings.note: Ketill attacked Þiðrandi after Gunnsteinn Kóreksson's spear-throw at his servant Ásbjörn; Þiðrandi repeatedly offered terms. Ketill's son is Þorkell (fullspakur).
